answers.core:
I think this could be implemented as a plugin, but
- This would require some rather non-trivial and ugly hacks with ScriptEditor
- I hope this would be used often - for example every time a new plugin is installed from the AssetLib Godot would automatically add all addon scripts to the readonly scripts list by default)
I believe this could be used by the engine in some other cases as well.

title: Add ability to make a script read-only in ScriptEditor
